mapper.select: SELECT aio.id, aio.event_id, aio.change_kind, aio.payload, aio.status, aio.retry_count, aio.max_retry, aio.next_retry_at, aio.last_error, aio.locked_by, aio.locked_at, aio.processed_at, aio.source_module, aio.source_biz_id, aio.created_at, aio.updated_at, aio.created_by, aio.updated_by, aio.remark FROM sys_authorization_invalidation_outbox aio WHERE aio.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM( CASE WHEN aio.status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS pending_count, SUM( CASE WHEN aio.status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS processing_count, SUM( CASE WHEN aio.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS success_count, SUM( CASE WHEN aio.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS failed_count, SUM( CASE WHEN aio.status = 'DEAD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS dead_count FROM sys_authorization_invalidation_outbox aio

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(aio.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS bucket,
DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB( aio.created_at, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(aio.created_at) DAY ), '%Y-%m-%d' ) AS bucket,
COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM( CASE WHEN aio.status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS failed_count, SUM( CASE WHEN aio.status = 'DEAD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS dead_count FROM sys_authorization_invalidation_outbox aio WHERE aio.created_at >= #{query.startTime} AND aio.created_at <= #{query.endTime} GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket ASC
